title: 第17章 明明躺在病床上却感受到了家的温暖第18章 是买还是不买呢
content_zh:
;;
“变革？因为灵气么？”
“不错。”
“可……”
云阳欲言又止，老实说他并没有在空气中感知到有灵气的存在。
可如果现实中没有灵气可供吸纳的话，又怎么能称得上“变革”呢？
有一瞬间云阳甚至怀疑自己体内的力量和黎重说的不是一回事。
不过，顾然体内涌动的力量毫无疑问就是和自己一样的灵力。
似乎是察觉到了云阳心中的疑惑，黎重也是解释道：“看来你对灵力的感知很敏锐，不错，虽然你我体内都有灵力，但现在在你我周围并不存在灵气这种东西。”
“用你们年轻人的话讲，如果把现实世界比作一场游戏，那你我就是进入测试服的那一小撮人，在灵气还没有大规模复苏之时，体内就凭空出现了灵力。”
“咱们这种人也被叫作灵力适应者。”
“等等。”云阳突然打断道：“你刚刚说‘灵力大规模复苏’，是不是说，现实中其实也有小范围的灵力复苏了？”
“看来你语文学的不错，没错，就咱们国内而言，目前有三处‘灵眼’中存在着稀薄的灵力。”
“灵眼？”
“不错。”黎重点了点头，从文件夹里取出一张夏国地图，在地图的中部，西北处还有东南角分别画了一个圈。
“这就是三处灵眼的位置，不过这些灵眼的规模极小，灵气稀薄的就像沙漠里的水一样。”
“但有灵力的话，那就可以修炼了啊！”
“哈哈哈！”听见云阳这话，黎重不由得笑道：“少年你以为这是修仙小说呢？有灵气不代表就能修炼啊。”
“emmm，没有修炼功法？”
“差不多。”黎重将那张地图收起来，继续说道；“灵气确实能被吸收，但吸收进体内的话也只是会补充体内用掉的灵力，并不会扩大体内灵力的容量，尽管官方的研究人员在不断的努力研究，但就目前看来，收效甚微。”

“可以说，灵力适应者在觉醒灵力的那一刻，实力的上限就已经被锁死了，就算想尽办法从身体素质，或者装备上提升实力，那也最多提升一个等级罢了，而灵力量更是想尽办法都不得提升半分。”
云阳若有所思的点了点头。
可自己好像……有修炼功法来着。
“因为空气中没有灵气的原因，我们体内的灵力也只能通过进食所获的的能量来慢慢转化，效率极慢，我一个兵级的灵力适应者从零开始恢复灵力至少需要一周时间。
但少年你好像不一样，你在灵气恢复速度上似乎天赋异禀，仅仅一晚就将你体内那堪称巨量的灵力完全恢复。”
巨量？
云阳眉头微挑，自己这炼气四层的修为也能被称为“巨量”吗？
“难道我……很强吗？”
“不要怀疑自己，少年，你很强！从表现力来看，你现在足有将级强者的实力！而将级实力的存在，除了你以外，在整个云梦行省里也只有一人！”
“……”云阳指向自己，有些不确定的问道：“我？这么强？”
“对！没错少年，就是你！”
黎重重重的拍了拍云阳的肩膀，眼神中很是器重。
好吧，现实世界的超凡力量水平比自己想象中更低。
“话说。”云阳又问道：“你们说将级兵级之类的评级是怎么评的？”
“忘了给你介绍了，这个评级是根据破坏力表现来评定的，从高到低，分为帝、王、帅、将、兵、卒这六个等级。”
“看来我的实力差不多也就处于中等水平。”

"Change? Is it because of aura?"
"Not bad."
"But..."
Yunyang hesitated to speak. To be honest, he did not sense the presence of spiritual energy in the air.
But if there is no spiritual energy to absorb in reality, how can it be called "change"?
For a moment, Yunyang even suspected that the power in his body was different from what Li Zhong said.
However, the power surging in Gu Ran's body was undoubtedly the same spiritual power as his own.
Seemingly aware of the doubts in Yunyang's heart, Li Zhong also explained: "It seems that you are very sensitive to spiritual energy. Yes, although we have spiritual energy in our bodies, there is no such thing as spiritual energy around you and me."
"In the words of you young people, if the real world is compared to a game, then you and I are the small group of people who entered the test server. Before the spiritual energy has recovered on a large scale, spiritual power appeared in the body out of thin air."
"People like us are also called spiritual adaptors."
"Wait a minute." Yunyang suddenly interrupted: "You just said 'large-scale recovery of spiritual power'. Does that mean that in reality, there is also a small-scale recovery of spiritual power?"
"It seems that you are good at philology. Yes, as far as our country is concerned, there are currently three 'spiritual eyes' that contain thin spiritual power."
"Spirit eye?"
"Not bad." Li Dian nodded, took out a map of Xia Kingdom from the folder, and drew a circle in the middle, northwest and southeast corners of the map.
"This is the location of the three spiritual eyes, but these spiritual eyes are extremely small in size, and the spiritual energy is as thin as the water in the desert."
"But if you have spiritual power, you can practice!"
"Hahaha!" Hearing Yunyang's words, Li Zhong couldn't help but laugh: "Young man, do you think this is a novel about cultivating immortals? Just because you have aura, doesn't mean you can cultivate."
"Emmm, you don't have any practice skills?"
"Absolutely." Li Zhong put the map away and continued; "Spiritual energy can indeed be absorbed, but if it is absorbed into the body, it will only replenish the spiritual power used in the body, and will not expand the capacity of the spiritual power in the body. Although official researchers are constantly working hard to study it, it seems that the results are very little."
"It can be said that the upper limit of spiritual power adaptors' strength has been locked the moment they awaken their spiritual power. Even if they try their best to improve their strength through physical fitness or equipment, it will only increase by one level at most, and their spiritual power cannot be increased by even half a point."
Yunyang nodded thoughtfully.
But it seems that I... have some cultivation techniques.
"Because there is no spiritual energy in the air, the spiritual power in our bodies can only be transformed slowly through the energy obtained from eating. The efficiency is extremely slow. It will take at least a week for me, a soldier-level spiritual power adaptor, to recover his spiritual power from scratch.
But boy, you seem to be different. You seem to be gifted at the speed of spiritual energy recovery. You can completely restore the huge amount of spiritual energy in your body in just one night. "
Huge amount?
Yunyang raised his eyebrows slightly. Can his fourth level of Qi refining be called "giant"?
"Am I... very strong?"
"Don't doubt yourself, young man, you are very strong! Judging from your performance, you are now strong enough to be a general-level strongman! And apart from you, there is only one person with general-level strength in the entire Yunmeng Province!"
"..." Yun Yang pointed at himself and asked with some uncertainty: "Me? So strong?"
"Yes! That's right young man, it's you!"
Li Zhong patted Yunyang's shoulder heavily with a serious look in his eyes.
Well, the level of supernatural power in the real world is lower than you think.
"Speaking of which," Yunyang asked again, "How do you rate generals, soldiers, etc.?"
"I forgot to introduce it to you. This rating is based on destructive performance. From high to low, it is divided into six levels: emperor, king, commander, general, soldier, and pawn.. "
“It seems that my strength is almost at the middle level. "
